name: Terminal profile card introduces the maker
looks: A small monospace card, styled like a config file, lists a handful of field-value rows (a handle, a location, a role, a stance) typing in one after another. A short line of prose sits beside it explaining why the card exists, in a lighter, human voice distinct from the mono rows.
build: Fixed-width mono card, rows clip in top to bottom 100-150ms apart, label first then value in a brighter weight. The prose line beside it fades in once the card finishes, in a different typeface from the mono rows to keep the two voices visually distinct (see `dual-voice-type.md`).
sound: A soft mechanical key-tick per row, quiet under the prose line.
prompt: Show a small monospace card styled like a config file, a handful of field-value rows typing in to introduce the maker (a handle, a place, a role, a stance), with a short human-voice line beside it in a different typeface explaining why it's there.
